name: Multiarte
description: Uruguayan online store of art and craft supplies: decoupage, blanks for decorating, canvases, sublimation, paints, brushes, crafts and creative stationery. Ships nationwide through UES, DAC or Mirtrans.
description_es: Tienda en línea uruguaya de insumos de arte y manualidades: decoupage, bases para decorar, bastidores, sublimación, pinturas, pinceles, manualidades y papelería creativa. Envía a todo el país por UES, DAC o Mirtrans.

ships_to.notes: Shipping page states shipping to all of Uruguay via UES, DAC or Mirtrans

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Shipping page says pickup at the store is possible if coordinated beforehand

shopping_notes: WooCommerce store; checkout via Mercado Pago. Free shipping above a stated minimum.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping carriers, free-shipping threshold, pickup
